title: Hermeus section label
description: The index label that opens every section: a tiny tracked number over a plain section name, ruled off by a full-width grey hairline, with an optional button at the right. While it scrolls into view the number fades up, the name rises out of a clip line and the hairline draws from left to right, all tied to the scroll.
notes: CSS scroll-driven animation; without support, and under reduced motion, everything shows in place
name: hermeus-section-label

props.name: action
props.description: shown at the right end of the row, e.g. a button

props.name: as
props.description: the heading level of the name (default h2)
